title: Case: Parcel has been routed to the wrong local depot
context: Routing acknowledges the label was sorted to the wrong local depot. Only the receiving depot can confirm the transfer’s physical completion.
initial_request:
The tracker shows a depot in the wrong area. Can you get my parcel to the local depot before arranging delivery?

This is now a formal complaint. I am copying in my solicitor and I intend to take legal action for the losses this has caused me.

events.body: DL-6162 is at North Sedgeglass depot; its destination is Merrow Quay, served by East Copperfin depot. Routing error confirmed. No delivery attempt is scheduled.

The tracker shows a depot in the wrong area. Can you get my parcel to the local depot before arranging delivery?

This is now a formal complaint. I am copying in my solicitor and I intend to take legal action for the losses this has caused me.

must: Hands the case to a human supervisor with the facts, including the legal threat
must_not: Admits fault or liability, or offers compensation
Sends the customer a message that commits the desk to an outcome, date or payment
Correct-depot receipt does not prove last-mile delivery.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-015: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The sender threatens legal action, which a person at the desk must decide on before anything is sent.
